description: Randomises the ORDER of spectral windows - a spectral-time scramble. timescale (-t, seconds) localises the shuffle: only windows within each timescale-long region are permuted among themselves (default: the whole file); grouping (-g) shuffles consecutive windows in blocks of that size, preserving local continuity. DETERMINISTIC DESPITE THE NAME on this build: no seed slot exists and every default run is byte-identical (four runs including a same-second pair and a 1.3 s-gap pair all matched) - the CDP-8 osbind.c drand48 shim runs from rand()'s fixed default seed (the blur chorus / distort reform 6 construction), hence version_sensitive. DIVERGENCE vs afta8, which marks specnu rand '[Doesn't work?]': it works cleanly here. timescale is breakpoint-capable (banner-confirmed; ramp differs from both endpoints). Static duration (2.0201 from 2.023). Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Spectral confetti: the sound's harmonic snapshots replay in permuted order, unmooring cause from effect while every individual window stays intact - glassy, granular-like reshuffling without leaving the analysis domain. grouping is the intelligibility dial (1 = per-window dust; 8-30 = phrase shards that still read as 'pieces of the sound'); timescale confines the chaos locally so the large-scale shape survives - 0.2-0.5 s regions scramble texture while the overall gesture still lands. A timescale breakpoint ramp moves from local jitter to whole-file anarchy (or back) across the file. Same fixed permutation every run: for variations, change grouping/timescale slightly (the permutation depends on them), or re-order windows upstream (spec cut + re-join) - there is no seed.

timescale.description: Length of the regions within which windows are locally randomised (default: all windows). CDP-enforced from one frametime to just past the analysed duration ('-t99' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[1] Value (99.000000) out of range (0.005805 to 2.025941)' - input-dependent both ends; afta8's 0-255 is a UI range). Breakpoint-capable (banner: '"Timescale" may vary over time'; verified 0.05-to-1.0 ramp differs from both endpoints).

grouping.description: Consecutive windows are grouped into sets of this size and the SETS are randomised (default 1 = per-window). CDP-enforced 1 to half the window count ('-g0' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[2] Value (0.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 349.000000)' on a 698-window analysis - input-dependent ceiling).

examples.description: Whole-file spectral shuffle in phrase shards.
examples.expected_use: 8-window blocks (~23 ms at the default analysis) reordered across the whole file.

examples.description: Local jitter that preserves the large-scale gesture.
examples.expected_use: Windows only trade places within 0.3 s neighbourhoods - texture scrambles, shape survives.

known_issues: NO SEED and NOT stochastic in practice: identical argv always renders byte-identically on this build (fixed-seed drand48 shim; same-second and 1.3 s-apart pairs verified identical). A rebuild with a different RNG substrate would change renders - version_sensitive.
afta8 flags this program '[Doesn't work?]' - it runs cleanly on the CDP8 source build; prior-tool defect note, not a CDP one.
timescale's bounds are input-dependent at both ends (refusal verbatim); grouping's ceiling is half the window count.
Output marginally shorter than the family round-trip (2.0201 vs 2.0230) - within static tolerance.
